mapper.select: select id, task_no as taskNo, plan_id as planId, plan_name_snapshot as planName, inspector_id as inspectorId, inspector_name_snapshot as inspectorName, task_date as taskDate, deadline_at as deadlineAt, status, equipment_count as equipmentCount, completed_equipment_count as completedEquipmentCount, started_at as startedAt, completed_at as completedAt, cancel_reason as cancelReason, created_at as createdAt from inspection_task where id = #{taskId}

select equipment_id as equipmentId, equipment_code_snapshot as equipmentCode, equipment_name_snapshot as equipmentName, area_name_snapshot as areaName, equipment_status_snapshot as status from inspection_task_equipment where task_id = #{taskId} order by id

select inspection_item_id as inspectionItemId, item_code_snapshot as itemCode, item_name_snapshot as itemName, check_method_snapshot as checkMethod, standard_description_snapshot as standardDescription, result_type_snapshot as resultType, unit_snapshot as unit, min_value_snapshot as `minValue`, max_value_snapshot as `maxValue`, is_required_snapshot as `required` from inspection_task_item where task_id = #{taskId} order by id
mapper.update:
update inspection_task
set status = 'IN_PROGRESS', started_at = #{startedAt}, version = version + 1
where id = #{taskId} and status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: select id, inspector_id as inspectorId, status from inspection_task where id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: update inspection_task set status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 where id = #{taskId} and status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: select id, plan_id as planId, inspector_id as inspectorId, inspector_name_snapshot as inspectorName, status from inspection_task where id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: update inspection_task set status = 'COMPLETED', completed_equipment_count = #{equipmentCount}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, version = version + 1 where id = #{taskId} and status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.insert: insert into inspection_task (task_no, plan_id, plan_name_snapshot, inspector_id, inspector_name_snapshot, task_date, scheduled_at, deadline_at, status, equipment_count) values (#{taskNo}, #{planId}, #{planNameSnapshot}, #{inspectorId}, #{inspectorNameSnapshot}, #{taskDate}, #{scheduledAt}, #{deadlineAt}, 'PENDING', #{equipmentCount})

insert into inspection_task_equipment (task_id, equipment_id, equipment_code_snapshot, equipment_name_snapshot, equipment_type_id, area_id, area_name_snapshot, equipment_status_snapshot, sort_no) values
(#{item.taskId}, #{item.equipmentId}, #{item.equipmentCodeSnapshot}, #{item.equipmentNameSnapshot}, #{item.equipmentTypeId}, #{item.areaId}, #{item.areaNameSnapshot}, #{item.equipmentStatusSnapshot}, #{item.sortNo})

insert into inspection_task_item (task_id, inspection_item_id, item_code_snapshot, item_name_snapshot, check_method_snapshot, standard_description_snapshot, result_type_snapshot, unit_snapshot, min_value_snapshot, max_value_snapshot, is_required_snapshot, sort_no) values
(#{item.taskId}, #{item.inspectionItemId}, #{item.itemCodeSnapshot}, #{item.itemNameSnapshot}, #{item.checkMethodSnapshot}, #{item.standardDescriptionSnapshot}, #{item.resultTypeSnapshot}, #{item.unitSnapshot}, #{item.minValueSnapshot}, #{item.maxValueSnapshot}, #{item.requiredSnapshot}, #{item.sortNo})
mapper.select: select e.id as equipment_id, e.code as equipment_code_snapshot, e.name as equipment_name_snapshot, e.equipment_type_id, e.area_id, a.name as area_name_snapshot, e.status as equipment_status_snapshot, row_number() over (order by e.id) as sort_no from inspection_plan_equipment pe inner join equipment e on e.id = pe.equipment_id inner join area a on a.id = e.area_id where pe.plan_id = #{planId} order by e.id

select ii.id as inspection_item_id, ii.code as item_code_snapshot, ii.name as item_name_snapshot, ii.check_method as check_method_snapshot, ii.standard_description as standard_description_snapshot, ii.result_type as result_type_snapshot, ii.unit as unit_snapshot, ii.min_value as min_value_snapshot, ii.max_value as max_value_snapshot, ii.is_required as required_snapshot, pi.sort_no from inspection_plan_item pi inner join inspection_item ii on ii.id = pi.inspection_item_id where pi.plan_id = #{planId} order by pi.sort_no, ii.id
